title: Game Theory and Applications in Economics - Business

skill_outcomes.outcome_description: Differentiate types of games, understand game structures, relate to economic and business situations.

skill_outcomes.skill_name: Nash Equilibrium Static Games Full Information
skill_outcomes.outcome_description: Understand and find Nash equilibrium in static games with full information.

skill_outcomes.skill_name: Nash Equilibrium Dynamic Games Full Information
skill_outcomes.outcome_description: Understand and find Nash equilibrium in dynamic games with full information.

skill_outcomes.skill_name: Comparing Nash Equilibrium with Other Optimal Solutions
skill_outcomes.outcome_description: Compare Nash equilibrium with other optimal solutions, integrate with other methods in analysis, evaluation, critique, and decision-making.
Identify standard game problems in economics and business, describe situations using game theory.

skill_outcomes.skill_name: Determining Strategies and Nash Equilibrium in Games
skill_outcomes.outcome_description: Identify strategies and Nash equilibrium in games.

skill_outcomes.skill_name: Analyzing Impact of Factors on Existence of Equilibrium
skill_outcomes.outcome_description: Analyze and evaluate the impact of factors on the existence of equilibrium and game solutions.
Critique theoretical and practical issues in economics and business, make decisions and recommend strategies.

skill_outcomes.skill_name: Describing Real Situations Using Game Theory
skill_outcomes.outcome_description: Describe real situations in economics and business using game theory methods, find strategies and outcomes.
Solve practical problems with available information and data, determine Nash equilibrium and analyze.
Evaluate policies and propose strategies with specific and realistic situations.
Present and negotiate real situations with knowledge from game theory, individually or in groups.
Self-study and actively engage in understanding, learning, researching situations and solving exercises, addressing practical issues.
Awareness and capability for active teamwork in researching, learning, and solving practical issues.
